description: Source code for a batch report worker in a Mattermost server project, handling report chunk processing, job management, and report completion.

classes.name: BatchReportWorkerAppIFace
classes.description: Interface defining methods for report chunk management and report sending.

classes.name: BatchReportWorker
classes.description: Struct representing a worker that handles batch report generation and processing.

methods.name: MakeBatchReportWorker
methods.description: Factory function to create a new BatchReportWorker instance.

methods.name: doBatch
methods.description: Performs a batch operation, fetching data, processing chunks, and completing the report.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes a single report chunk and saves it.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the report by compiling and sending it to the user, then cleans up chunks.
